original_test_intent: Determine which exact SMBIOS Type 38 byte the source intended and validate its defined value before and after reboot; the current label does not identify that byte.
original_method: The source proposes dmidecode Type 38 followed by grep for the literal token BYTE, then a pre/post-reboot correctness comparison. Because neither Items nor Procedure supplies a field name, offset, length or bit semantics, the method cannot bind evidence to one Type 38 member.
manual_activity: The source owner must identify the intended byte and acceptance contract. This is semantic clarification, not a manual core test classification.
required_inputs: Exact Type 38 field name and whether the row is distinct from adjacent fields
SMBIOS structure offset and length plus applicable version
Bit or enumeration semantics and expected platform value
Field-specific read-only decoder/parser and approved reboot plan
safety_requirements: Do not infer Interrupt Number or any other adjacent byte solely from row order.
Do not treat grep output containing the word BYTE as field evidence.
Do not access, alter or probe BMC resources to compensate for the missing test identity.
Preserve the source contradiction and do not reboot until a corrected executable contract is approved.
agent_execution_scope: Preserve and compare source artifacts, record the ambiguity and, after owner correction, perform field-specific read-only raw/decoded collection and approved pre/post-reboot comparison.
Do not execute or report a result for the unresolved BYTE selector.
engineer_actions: Name the intended field/offset/semantics and decide whether the row should be corrected, merged with an adjacent case or removed as an artifact.
Approve the corrected expected value and later issue the formal verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Not fit: dmidecode does not expose a uniquely defined Type 38 field named BYTE, so the grep can yield nothing or unrelated text.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Remain non-executable until the owner supplies a concrete field. Then archive full raw/decoded Type 38 and select by verified offset/field semantics rather than the generic token.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The Type 38 scope, script URL and 5/5-minute values are retained, but they cannot resolve the missing target.

modernized_recommendation.status: OWNER CLARIFICATION REQUIRED BEFORE METHOD DESIGN
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Correct the case with an exact field name, offset/length, SMBIOS version and expected semantics; only then define a raw-offset/decoded comparison and reboot persistence check.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Undetermined until the intended Type 38 byte is identified.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record the SMBIOS version after clarification.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: The applicable SMBIOS Type 38 field definition must be supplied for the selected offset.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Rejects an unbound text grep and requires an identity-bound field parser.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Avoids silently validating the wrong byte; executable coverage remains intentionally unavailable while identity is unresolved.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Owner-approved field identity and acceptance contract.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Choosing the adjacent Interrupt Number byte would be an unsupported inference and could conceal a source defect.

project_override_considerations: A project may provide the missing identity and expected value, but a project override must not silently rewrite the Master Source; the clarification and provenance must be recorded.
expected_evidence: Owner clarification with exact field, offset/length, SMBIOS reference and expected semantics
Disposition as corrected distinct case, merge/duplicate or removal
Only after correction: complete pre/post raw and decoded evidence plus reboot authorization

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items names only the generic data token BYTE, while DeepSeek/round-02 grep that token as if it were a unique Type 38 field. No source fact identifies which byte is intended, and silently substituting the adjacent Interrupt Number would rewrite the test.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The core target and acceptance semantics are irreducibly ambiguous. A package, expected value or approval alone cannot make the current row executable.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Rejects its false assumption that BYTE is a valid unique dmidecode field label.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Agrees that the row must remain blocked pending exact field identity and a corrected contract.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Distinguishes a true semantic BLOCKED condition from ordinary missing project parameters and records the project-overlay boundary.

review_improvement: Prevents an empty or incidental grep match from becoming false evidence and prevents the reviewer from inventing an Interrupt Number test by adjacency.
independent_technical_reasoning: Type 38 contains multiple scalar and composite bytes. A bare type word supplies neither offset nor semantics, so no deterministic observation can be mapped to this source row without owner clarification.
